title: Unresponsive editor due to long shader comment blocks
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.7.beta4.official [dff2b9bb6] and v4.7.beta3.official [8608217].
I also tried it in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8] where the issue is less severe but still noticeable.

### System information

macOS (Apple Silicon), PowerBook M1, v4.7.beta4.official (and before), all renderers

### Issue description

Long /** */ documentation-comment blocks in `.gdshader` files slow down any scene in-editor that uses the shader, with long freeze/unresponsive times.

The freeze grows with the number and/or length of `/** */` blocks: 1 block is relatively instant; it becomes seconds, then minutes as blocks are added. The more complex a project becomes, the more long doc blocks seem to cause issues. In a reasonably complex project that usually saves the main scene in 2–5 seconds, it took minutes to add an object with a `ShaderMaterial` that has long doc blocks. Saving the scene took 30+ minutes every time, with the Godot editor being completely unresponsive, showing the colourful circular "cursor of doom" on my MacBook Pro.

- The content text of doc blocks is irrelevant (plain lorem ipsum ASCII text without markup reproduces the issue). 
- Converting the blocks to plain `//` comments removes the unresponsive hang entirely.
- Exported games are unaffected (only the editor parses doc comments).
- The issue happens with any renderer and points to an issue with parsing long doc comments in the editor.
- The issue may have originated in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/90161 , [possibly in this regex pattern](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/90161/changes#diff-067f83187419fe00fff5ff7d7e726ff4bd3f6be24ea0920d990ff495a151b7bcR156)? `[\r\n]` _may_ be redundant since `[^*]` already covers newlines, and having both in the regex could backtrack catastrophically in long doc blocks.

This was driving me crazy because, for a long time, I was suspecting that the shader code or possibly a corrupt shader or shader cache file was causing the issue. In the end, it was just long doc blocks.



### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached minimal reproduction project below.
2. In the `main.tscn` scene, add the saved scene `doc_comment_blocks_shader_issue.tscn` to the scene tree.
3. Adding the scene to the main scene tree should create a very noticeable unresponsive hang in the editor (tested on an M1 MacBook Pro).
4. Saving the scene may cause an even longer unresponsive hang.
5. Opening the `doc_comment_blocks_shader_issue.tscn` scene itself and navigating to the root node's material and shader parameters will also cause longer freezes.
6. A more complex project will suffer extreme unresponsiveness with fewer and/or shorter doc blocks compared to this minimal reproduction project. The original shader I used had a few multi-line `/** */` blocks: 4, 5, 9, 17 and 21 lines.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[shader-doc-blocks-bug-minimal-reproduction-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28422268/shader-doc-blocks-bug-minimal-reproduction-project.zip)
